packageRules.description: One dependency commit per weekly run on main, not one per package
Python pin must stay inside the CI-tested matrix (ci.yml tops at 3.14)
tree-sitter 0.26+ does not resolve: tree-sitter-clojure 0.1.0, its only release, needs ^0.25.6 under the same links key. Lift when it moves
tree-sitter-graphql 0.3 needs tree-sitter-language ^0.1.8; brokk-tree-sitter-kotlin =0.4.6 pins =0.1.7. Lift when the kotlin pin moves

plugin/uv.lock is written by cd.yml once PyPI serves a release, seeded with uv.lock: the set CI tested. A bump here locks versions CI never ran, and plugin/pyproject.toml's diffctx pin moves only with a release
